generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Department Registration Details
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Banker Details

To qualify for award of this contract each tenderer in his name should have in the last five years period (i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26) Turnover Certificate obtained from Charted Accountant and achieved in at least two financial years Turnover (in all classes of civil Engineering construction works only) of Rs. 8.36 lakhs (usually not less than the estimated cost under this contract

In last five years (i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26) Satisfactorily completed as a prime contractor for at least one similar nature of work done 50% of the cost of the work i.e., not less than the amount Rs 4.18 lakhs, certificate issued from the rank of Executive Engineer and above for the same should be furnished by the contractor. (With Work Indent Number).
EMD may be paid fully by E-payment Rs. 21,000/-
Any damage during the progress of work, the damage cost should be beared by the contractor
Tender processing fee will not be refundable or exchangeable in case of cancellation of tender

Contractor should made an agreement within 20 days of tender acceptance date and work should be carried out with in the 1 week time after agreement. If not tender will be cancelled at the contractors own risk and cost
Security deposit at the rate of 5% of tender cost should be made in favour of Executive Engineer in the form of DD / FDR / NSC/ BG (NSC should be fledge in the name of PDO)
Acceptence / Cancellation of the tenders are reserved by under signed without any reasons for the same
Contractor should obey with the above conditions in addition to the KW-1
Tender Completion Period 6. months including Mansoon
The contractor participating in the tender must upload a photo and certificate of site inspection jointly with the concerned PDO before submitting the tender.
GST shall be paid to the tendered amount separately.
PWD Registration Certificate

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Tendere Must Submnit PAN & GST Certificate

To quality for award of this contant each tenderer in his name should have in the 2021-22 to 2025-26 years period achieved in at least two financial years an average finance turnover of Rs 8.36 lakhs usually not less than amount put to tender from CA on letter Head with UDIN No otherwise bid will be directly disqualified
Work Order / Commitments of ongoing works issued by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer

Tenderer must have of value 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 to 2025-26 satisfactory completed as a prime contractor at least one similar nature of Work of 50PERCENT of the Amount Put to Tender. Not less than Rs 4.18 lakhs Work Done certificate
Accurate postal address and Phone / Cell Number

Tender who meet the above specified minimum qualifying will only be qualified if there available tender capacity is more than the total tinder value the web available tender capacity will be calculated as under associated available tender capacity A X N X 2.50 - B
Site Inspection Photo and Certificate from PDO

itemList.description: Providing & fixing 10 mm thick plaster of Paris (gypsum anhydrous) ceiling up to a height of 5 m above floor over first class kail wood strips 25x6mm with 10mm gap in between and reinforced with rabbit wire mesh fixed to wooden frame. Flat surfaces 25 mm thick.

Providing and fixing in position fully panelled Matti/Nandi wood shutters for doors with stiles and rails of 40mm thick with bottom and lock rails 180mm wide top rail and stiles 100mm wide as per drawing and panels of 25mm thick including cost of materials, labour, usage charges complete as per specifications (excluding cost of fixtures).

Providing and fixing in wall lining flat pressed three layer (medium density) particle board or graded wood Pre-Laminated one side decorative lamination and other side balancing lamination Grade I, Type II, IS: 12823 marked, including priming coat on unexposed arrangement and screws etc. complete. 25 mm thick.
Providing and fixing 4mm thick coir veneer board, ISI marked IS: 14842, plain lining with necessary screws, priming coat on unexposed surface etc., complete.

Providing and fixing in position aluminium windows and ventilators as per approved drawings with sliding shutters using three track window frame of size 92x31.75mm bottom section 1.3mm thick, weight 1.07kg/m, sides and top sections 1.3mm thick, weight 0.933 kg/m, shutter frame section comprising top and bottom section of size 40mmx18mm, wall thickness 1.25mm, weight 0.417 kg/m, shutter side outer 40mmx18mm wall thickness 1.25mm, weight 0.417 kg/m, shutter interlock section 40mmx26.7mm wall thickness 1.1mm, weight 0.469 kg/m, the shutters mounted on nylon rollers with approved fittings, 5.5mm thick plain glass, rubber beading, powder coated.

Providing and fixing stainless steel 304 grade for staircase railings, balconies, ramps, with hand rail 50mm 16 gauge hollow pipe welded to vertical hollow 50mm dia pipe of 16 gauge, spaced at 1.20m regular intervals and 5 Nos of 25mm dia SS hollow horizontal pipes welded to vertical 50mm dia hollow pipe, fixed to concrete with expansion bolts etc. complete.

Providing and fixing Chlorinated Poly Vinyl Chloride (CPVC) pipes having thermal stability for hot and cold water supply including all CPVC plain and brass threaded fittings, jointing with CPVC solvent cement, trenching, refilling & testing complete. (External Work) - 20mm Nominal Dia.

Providing and fixing white vitreous china pedestal type water closet (European type W.C. pan) with seat and lid, 10 litre low level white P.V.C. flushing cistern, flush pipe, handle conforming to IS: 7231, all fittings and fixtures complete.
Providing and fixing Bib cock with wall flange made of Stainless steel with all concealed fitting arrangements & accessories complete - Economy.

Providing and placing on terrace (at all floor levels) polyethylene water storage tanks as per IS: 12701 marked, with cover suitable locking arrangements and making necessary holes for inlet, outlet and over flow pipes, but without fittings.

Supplying heavy gauge PVC Conduit Pipe dia 20mm dia 2mm thick with suitable size bends, metal junction boxes, adhesive paste etc., by groove cutting in the wall and fixing by bracing U or J hooks and cement plastering up to the wall surface and run with 18 SWG GI fish wire run throughout the conduit wherever necessary.

Point wiring using Copper wire with switch: Supplying and wiring adopting loop system in existing PVC Conduit / casing capping using 1100V grade, COPPER conductor flexible multistrand FRLS PVC insulated, 2 X 1.5 Sq mm Cable confirming to GTP, with a 6 Amps flush type SP control switch fixed on existing plastic sheet / gang box, terminated in wood/PVC round block for each outlet - GROUP A: Short point upto 3 Mtr from tapping point to outlet via switch.

Point wiring using Copper wire with switch: Supplying and wiring adopting loop system in existing PVC Conduit / casing capping using 1100V grade, COPPER conductor flexible multistrand FRLS PVC insulated, 2 X 1.5 Sq mm Cable confirming to GTP, with 6 Amps switch - GROUP A: Medium point above 3M upto 6M from tapping point to outlet via switch.

Wiring for lighting / power circuit using one of PVC insulated 1100V grade, multistrand Copper conductor single core cable in open or concealed system of wiring using Class 'A' approved materials: 1.5 sqmm.

Wiring for lighting / power circuit using one of PVC insulated 1100V grade, multistrand Copper conductor single core cable in open or concealed system of wiring using Class 'A' approved materials: 2.5 sqmm.

Supply 6A flush/projected type socket and a 6 amps flush/projected type SP switch either surface/flush mounting in existing gang box or in 4mm thick plastic sheet and fixing over a flush mounted wooden box and wiring using necessary capacity wires: 6 Amps 3/5 Way.
Supplying and fixing of modular switch & connected accessories on existing modular switch plate as per IS 3854 and IS 1293: 32 Amps DP switch.
Supplying and fixing of modular switch & connected accessories on existing modular switch plate as per IS 3854 and IS 1293: 6/16 Amps Universal socket.

Supplying and fixing miniature circuit breakers on existing MCB distribution boards using necessary fixing materials and 'C' Type curve, indicator ON/OFF, energy class-3 with Short circuit breaking capacity of 10kA and complete wiring confirming to IEC 60898: 6-32 Amps DP.

Supplying and fixing regular MCB distribution boards on wall/wood board/flush mounting using required clamps, bolts, nuts etc., with provision for fixing single phase / 3 phase MCBs, powder coated MS enclosure (Double Door): 8 Way SP&N.

Supply of round/square recess/surface mounted rolling type LED Down light with GU 10 LED Lamp, die cast aluminium housing, white powder coated, swiveling eyeball unit, life 25000 burning hrs, 70% lumen maintenance, CRI  80, PF  0.9, 2 years warranty.

Supplying and fixing polished wood board made of not less than 15mm thick plank on both sides with planks made out of not more than 2 pieces, fixing to wall using tapered inverted wooden plugs, screws etc. (Size: 8 x 10 or 8 x 6 / 1.5).

Supplying capacitor type ceiling fan complete with down rod, blades, shackle, canopies etc., for operation on 230V, 50Hz, single phase AC supply conforming to ISS-374-1979 with double ball bearing system: 48" Sweep (1200mm) Regular model.
Supplying and fixing of modular switch & connected accessories on existing modular switch plate as per IS 3854 and IS 1293: Electronic stepped regulator.
Fixing all types and capacities fluorescent / false ceiling / spot light / CFL fittings on wall/ceiling/rafters/girders using 23/0.0076" twin PVC insulated wires, required round blocks and clamps.
